rule.kql: ADFPipelineRun | sort by TimeGenerated desc | where TimeGenerated >= ago(22m) and PipelineName == '{PipelineName}' and Status == 'Succeeded'  | project RunId, PipelineName, Parameters, Tags, UserProperties, Annotations,  Status, Start, End

ADFPipelineRun | where TimeGenerated >= ago(22m) and PipelineName == '{PipelineName}' and Status == 'Failed' | join kind=inner (ADFActivityRun | where Status == 'Failed' | project PipelineRunId, Errors = ErrorMessage) on $left.RunId == $right.PipelineRunId | sort by TimeGenerated desc | summarize PipelineName = any(PipelineName), Parameters = any(Parameters), Tags = any(Tags), UserProperties = any(UserProperties), Annotations = any(Annotations), Status = any(Status), Start = any(Start), End = any(End), ErrorMessage = strcat_array(make_list(Errors), ' | ') by RunId

ADFPipelineRun | sort by TimeGenerated desc | where TimeGenerated >= ago(22m) and PipelineName == '{PipelineName}' and Status == 'Cancelled'  | project RunId, PipelineName, Parameters, Tags, UserProperties, Annotations,  Status, Start, End

let ParamPipelineName = '{PipelineName}';let ParamTimeRange=22m;let Log = ADFPipelineRun| where PipelineName == 'PL_Log_Notification' and Status == 'Succeeded' and TimeGenerated > ago(ParamTimeRange) | sort by TimeGenerated desc | extend Params=parse_json(Parameters) | project ParentRunId=tostring(Params.runid), ParentPipelineName = tostring(Params.pipeline), LogKey1=Params.key1, LogKey2=Params.key2, LogKey3=Params.key3;ADFPipelineRun| where Status == 'Succeeded' and PipelineName == ParamPipelineName| sort by TimeGenerated desc| join kind=inner (Log) on $left.RunId == $right.ParentRunId| project RunId,PipelineName,Parameters,Tags,UserProperties,Annotations,Status,Start,End, LogKey1, LogKey2, LogKey3

let ParentPipelineName='{PipelineName}';let NoFilePipelineName='{NoFilePipelineName}';let AlertTimeRange=22m;let FamilyTimeRange=1d;let AllRuns=ADFPipelineRun | where TimeGenerated > ago(FamilyTimeRange) | where Status == 'Succeeded' | extend Predecessor=parse_json(Predecessors) | extend ParentRunId=tostring(Predecessor[0].PipelineRunId);let Level0=AllRuns | where PipelineName==ParentPipelineName and TimeGenerated > ago(AlertTimeRange) | extend Level=0 | extend RootId=RunId;let Level1=AllRuns | join kind=inner Level0 on $left.ParentRunId==$right.RunId | extend Level=1 | extend RootId=ParentRunId;let Level2=AllRuns | join kind=inner Level1 on $left.ParentRunId==$right.RunId | extend Level=2 | extend RootId=ParentRunId2;let Level3=AllRuns | join kind=inner Level2 on $left.ParentRunId==$right.RunId | extend Level=3 | extend RootId=ParentRunId2;let All=Level1 | project TimeGenerated,RootId,PipelineName,Level | union(Level2 | project TimeGenerated,RootId,PipelineName,Level) | union(Level3 | project TimeGenerated,RootId,PipelineName,Level) | order by Level asc,TimeGenerated asc;let Summary=All | summarize SubPipelines=strcat_array(make_list(PipelineName),',') by RootId;let PipelineRun=Level0 | join kind=leftouter Summary on $left.RunId==$right.RootId;PipelineRun | sort by TimeGenerated desc | where SubPipelines !contains NoFilePipelineName | project RunId,PipelineName,Parameters,Tags,UserProperties,Annotations,Status,Start,End,SubPipelines

let ParentPipelineName='{PipelineName}';let NoFilePipelineName='{NoFilePipelineName}';let AlertTimeRange=22m;let FamilyTimeRange=1d;let AllRuns=ADFPipelineRun | where TimeGenerated > ago(FamilyTimeRange) | where Status == 'Succeeded' | extend Predecessor=parse_json(Predecessors) | extend ParentRunId=tostring(Predecessor[0].PipelineRunId);let Level0=AllRuns | where PipelineName==ParentPipelineName and TimeGenerated > ago(AlertTimeRange) | extend Level=0 | extend RootId=RunId;let Level1=AllRuns | join kind=inner Level0 on $left.ParentRunId==$right.RunId | extend Level=1 | extend RootId=ParentRunId;let Level2=AllRuns | join kind=inner Level1 on $left.ParentRunId==$right.RunId | extend Level=2 | extend RootId=ParentRunId2;let Level3=AllRuns | join kind=inner Level2 on $left.ParentRunId==$right.RunId | extend Level=3 | extend RootId=ParentRunId2;let All=Level1 | project TimeGenerated,RootId,PipelineName,Level | union(Level2 | project TimeGenerated,RootId,PipelineName,Level) | union(Level3 | project TimeGenerated,RootId,PipelineName,Level) | order by Level asc,TimeGenerated asc;let Summary=All | summarize SubPipelines=strcat_array(make_list(PipelineName),',') by RootId;let PipelineRun=Level0 | join kind=inner Summary on $left.RunId==$right.RootId;PipelineRun | sort by TimeGenerated desc | where SubPipelines contains NoFilePipelineName | project RunId,PipelineName,Parameters,Tags,UserProperties,Annotations,Status,Start,End,SubPipelines
